scripts.typecheck: bun run --filter swarmie-desktop typecheck && bun run --filter @swarmie/client typecheck && bun run --filter @swarmie/ui typecheck
scripts.test: bun run test:ui && bun run --cwd apps/desktop test:web && bun run --cwd packages/clients/typescript test
scripts.check: bun run format:check && bun run typecheck && bun run lint:code && bun run test
scripts.format:shared:check: node node_modules/oxfmt/bin/oxfmt --check oxlint.config.ts oxfmt.config.ts package.json tsconfig.json .vscode packages/config packages/ui
scripts.check:ui: bun run format:shared:check && bun run --filter @swarmie/ui typecheck && bun run lint:shared
